$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Security Command Center (securitycenter.googleapis.com v2). See aws/s3.json for the contract. Core: core/gcp_scc_core.py over core/gcp_posture_core + the secscan threat detector + vuln_scan_core.

gcp.scc.sources_findings.title: Sources + findings — list/get with the filter grammar, orderBy, paging, :group, :setState, :setMute, :bulkMute, security marks
limitations: Built-in sources are Vyomi rule engines (Security Health Analytics-style misconfigurations, Event Threat Detection-style deterministic rules over the audit feed, Container Analysis-style image vulnerabilities from the advisory snapshot), not Google's detectors or threat intelligence.
Organization/folder parents aggregate the single simulated project. No attack paths, toxic combinations, BigQuery exports, resource value configs or IAM on sources.

gcp.scc.custom_findings.title: Custom sources and findings — create source, create/patch finding with real validation

gcp.scc.mute_configs.title: Mute configs — create/get/list/patch/delete; the filter mutes matching findings (muteInitiator set)

gcp.scc.notification_configs.title: Notification configs — filter-matched new/changed findings are published to the config's Pub/Sub topic in the simulator
limitations: Delivery runs on create/update requests and the shared scheduler tick (core/schedule_core, about every minute): offline from a background loop, on Nano only while the page is open; a finding that changes between ticks is delivered once with its latest state.
